Figure 2: Workflow of our POMDP-based task-alignment framework, illustrated with an example from Terminal-Bench. The assistant interacts with a user simulator whose responses are guided by an evolving intent state conditioned on the full specification and conversation history. At each turn, the assistant ranks candidate specifications (as an additional output just for evaluation), allowing us to track how interaction affects belief over the latent task.
